findings.summary: Post-create marker confirmation retried multiple distinct exact-marker issues, obscuring terminal ambiguity as generic retry failure.
Transient zero marker-search results after successful issue creation were not directly covered by regression proof.
The first zero-search regression consumed the empty search before POST, so it did not prove post-create search lag.
